thresholds.rule: every recorded run must meet both thresholds

version_bindings.application: ShiftMind evaluation harness single-turn runtime (evals/report.py) built through agent.runtime.create_agent_runtime with the configured settings
version_bindings.evaluator: ToolRoutingEvaluator v1 on live expectations (exact tool names, count and JSON arguments) decides each case; GroundingEvaluator and PolicyOutcomeEvaluator are recorded beside it and decide nothing
version_bindings.policy: NFR28: >=90% overall and 100% consequential/prohibited routing, in each of three passes, over live_eligible cases on capabilities the release configuration allows (Story 5.13 D5, D9)
version_bindings.prompt: versioned prompts in backend/evals/golden/**/*.json; system instructions in backend/agent/scheduling_instructions.py
version_bindings.solver: not applicable — the fixture projection and the eval double answer every capability; no CP-SAT run is started
version_bindings.tool: scheduling_baseline@1, scheduling_compute@1, scheduling_draft@1, scheduling_inspect@2, scheduling_optimize@1, shiftmind_demonstration@2
